item.title: Iran Official: US Economic Focus Shows Military Failure
item.description: Iran's regime says years of sanctions have not worked, dismissing Trump's economic threats.

item.title: Beatty Files Emergency Request to Block Trump's Name at Kennedy Center
item.description: Rep. Joyce Beatty asks a judge to prevent Trump's name from being restored at the Kennedy Center.

item.title: Trump announces economic pressure on Iran; Supreme Court to decide on White House ballroom
item.description: President Trump has imposed economic measures against Iran to push for renewed negotiations. The Supreme Court will also rule on the White House ballroom dispute.

item.title: Supreme Court permits Trump's ballroom construction to proceed temporarily
item.description: The decision follows prolonged legal exchanges between the Trump administration and the National Trust for Historic Preservation.
